schema.heldout_rows: same schema as train rows; held-out contains 400 DISTRACTOR rows (200 pairs) plus 200 UPDATED single rows.
schema.binding_pairs: JSONL pair records with pair_id,row_a_id,row_b_id,entity_a,entity_b,answer_a,answer_b. row_a is unchanged_entity/source_state; row_b is updated_entity/new_state. The source_sentence and update_sentence are identical across the two rows of each pair; only query_entity and final answer differ.
schema.contract: Full-phrase candidate comparison should score source_state and new_state in the same final frame The relevant state of {query_entity} is ___. Joint success requires row_a source_state>new_state and row_b new_state>source_state.
